definitions.full: H1355. gab [ גַּב ] noun [masculine] either back ( גַּב ᵑ7 back, top ; Biblical Hebrew גַּב , √ גנב ), or < side (√ גנב , compare Arabic side, Syriac side , √ ; — see also D WB 65 ); — plural suffix Dan 7:6 Kt wings עַלגַּֿבַּיהּ on its sides (Bev Behrm Dr; Qr גַּבַּהּ perhaps its back , so most).
